visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, pink eyeshadow, and a light blue floral dress smiles at the camera, holding a white and red 'Zuru Mini Brands Netflix' capsule. She is in a brightly lit indoor living room with a framed photo on the wall behind her. Captions appear at the bottom. (2) The camera moves to a close-up as she rotates the capsule, pointing at labels for 'Stranger Things,' 'Squid Game,' and 'Bridgerton.' She then peels away the outer plastic wrapping. (3) She opens the white plastic sphere to reveal five small items: four wrapped in white paper with red Netflix logos and one in a small transparent plastic bag. (4) Close-up shot of her holding a tiny, intricately folded paper prop titled 'Lady Whistledown's Society Papers.' She unfolds it to show dense, tiny printed text. (5) She unboxes a small transparent yellow piggy bank filled with miniature gold coin shapes. A small inset video from 'Squid Game' appears in the corner. (6) She opens a small red and black box to reveal a miniature 'Cobra Kai' karate figure in a white uniform. Variety text with a star emoji appears. (7) She opens more wrappers to find a 'Hopper' figure from 'Stranger Things' in a blue uniform and a miniature black electric guitar on a clear stand. (8) The woman holds up a long, folded collector's checklist, pointing to different categories like 'Common,' 'Rare,' and 'Legendary,' showing photos of various miniature items.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice begins speaking quickly over an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM track. The acoustic environment is quiet. (2) Sharp, high-frequency rustling sounds are heard as plastic packaging is manipulated and torn. The BGM remains steady with a prominent synth bass line. (3) A percussive 'click' and 'pop' occur as the plastic capsule is opened. The speaker's arousal level is high, characterized by sharp rising intonations. (4) Soft, broadband friction sounds occur as small paper wrappers are handled. A 'ding' SFX marks the reveal of a miniature item. (5) Loud paper ripping sounds coincide with the unboxing of the 'Cobra Kai' and 'Stranger Things' figures. The BGM maintains a consistent high-tempo energy. (6) The vocal delivery remains dense and fast-paced as she lists items from a guide, punctuated by short comedic 'boing' or 'whoosh' SFX during visual transitions.
